title: Hearty Pillowy Italian Kale Pasta
description: A comforting, earthy Italian one-pot dish featuring sautéed kale and pillowy pasta.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and salt-free seasoning blend; bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 8 minutes or until slightly reduced.
Add the pappardelle pasta to the skillet and stir to combine with the liquid.
Cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until the pasta is al dente.
Stir in the chopped kale and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the pasta to serving plates and top with grated Parmesan cheese.
Season with additional salt-free seasoning blend if desired.
